description: Turn Is Agentic reports into durable, scriptable readiness evidence.

novel_features.name: Snapshot ledger
novel_features.description: Keep a local, timestamped ledger of readiness reports and their provenance.

novel_features.name: Cross-report diff
novel_features.description: See which readiness scores and findings changed between two retained audits.

novel_features.name: Explainable policy gate
novel_features.description: Fail CI with an explicit, machine-readable readiness policy decision.

novel_features.name: Portfolio matrix
novel_features.description: Compare a fleet of public sites in one sortable score and issue matrix.

novel_features.name: Issue lifecycle queue
novel_features.description: Track when readiness findings first appeared, last appeared, were fixed, or regressed.

novel_features.name: Rate-aware fleet scheduler
novel_features.description: Refresh many targets with bounded concurrency, deduplication, and Retry-After-aware pacing.

novel_features.name: Evidence bundle
novel_features.description: Package a report and its provenance into a portable evidence artifact.
